blobatar 2.7.0, https://github.com/Alain00/blobatar, MIT (see LICENSE).

Hermes Desktop draws bot faces with this, and the bridge draws the same ones. It uses the copy inside
Hermes when there is one. A Hermes installed without Desktop, as on a server, has none, so this copy
is the fallback. Only dist/blob.js is kept, unchanged.
